component: VCF Automation (successor to vRealize Automation / VMware Aria Automation)
documented_api_title: VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API
specification_availability_note: VCF Automation ships no API specification in the Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so no OpenAPI document, repository commit or specification path backs this contract. The rendered xAPIs reference pages listed below are the authoritative public source and every one of them was read directly.

index_pages.documents: Broadcom xAPIs catalog; lists 'VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service' among the VCF Automation API family alongside VCF Automation Consumption and the Org Management entries
API landing page: documented title 'VMware Aria Automation Assembler IaaS API', its provisioning purpose, and the documented version 9.1 (latest)
Operation index: the HTTP method and path of every operation in the service, including the five operations projected into docs/contract.json

operations.documents: CspLoginSpecification request body (refreshToken, required), the AuthResponse reply (tokenType, token), the optional apiVersion query parameter, and the instruction to present the returned token as 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' on every other endpoint

The supported-versions document (supportedApis[].apiVersion, latestApiVersion in yyyy-MM-dd UTC form), that the operation declares no query parameter, and the note that the version parameter is mandatory for endpoints introduced after 2019-01-15 and recommended for the others

The MachineSpecification request body and each member's documented obligation, the optional apiVersion query parameter, the asynchronous 202 acceptance carrying a RequestTracker, and the 400/403 ServiceErrorResponse replies

The RequestTracker document (progress, message, status, resources, name, id, selfLink, deploymentId), the FINISHED / INPROGRESS / FAILED status values, the required id path parameter and the optional apiVersion query parameter
The Machine document returned for a provisioned machine, the required id path parameter, and both documented query parameters: the optional apiVersion and the optional $select subset selector
